summary: Cloud FinOps Training for cost allocation, optimisation, dashboards, and governance. Build practical controls for hybrid and multi-cloud estates.
lede: Cloud FinOps training helps you bring financial accountability into cloud operations, linking spend to products, services, applications, and business units. Using the FinOps Framework, FOCUS specification, and TBM Taxonomy, you will build practical approaches to allocation, forecasting, commitment utilisation, anomaly response, and unit-cost analysis. You will practise creating tagging controls, showback and chargeback models, KPI dashboards, governance routines, optimisation backlogs, and executive reports. Hands-on activities use AWS Cost Explorer, Microsoft Azure Cost Management, and Google Cloud cost data to support clearer decisions across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect cloud consumption with budgets, operating decisions, supplier contracts, and executive accountability. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with cloud services or technology finance and need a shared Cloud FinOps method across technical and commercial teams.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to cloud services, technology budgets, procurement, financial planning, or infrastructure operations. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with cloud billing concepts is useful, but the course introduces the FinOps Framework, FOCUS, tagging, allocation, and KPI concepts from a practical starting point. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the provided templates to your own operating context.
